# Signed history rewrite map

On 2026-08-24, the unpublished commits after `origin/main` were rewritten solely to add GPG commit signatures.
For every mapped commit, the tree, commit message, author identity/date, committer identity/date, and parent topology were preserved; parent object IDs changed only where an unpublished parent was likewise signed.
Historical validation/evidence files may retain a pre-sign identity when that identity is part of the bytes or provenance originally recorded. Use this map to resolve such identities to the canonical signed history.
